headline: Usiminas Returns to Profitability in Q3 with R$243 Million Net Income
summary: Usiminas posted a net income of R$243 million for the third quarter of 2026, reversing a R$3.5 billion loss from the same period last year. However, the figure fell short of market expectations.
why: Usiminas is a major Brazilian steel producer whose financial health reflects conditions in the domestic industrial and manufacturing sectors.

impacts.name: Usiminas
impacts.why: Although profits turned positive year-over-year, missing consensus analyst expectations typically pressures equity prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The reported quarterly profit missed consensus analyst estimates despite marking a year-over-year turnaround from prior losses.
